body: Filed on 2026-09-23 from the fresh-agent leg of V1-0146 (PR #102, extracted v0.7.0 build 46 archive, BASE d18db3d). Step 4: after deleting the stale map, the next pass exited 0 with complete:true while the sidecar was `??`; DOGFOOD.md names record-index-failed for that state. A later pass matched the docs.
